question: CDs and Hard disks are commonly called as
solution:
The correct answer is __**Secondary storage devices.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **CD:**

 
 
• A** compact disc** (CD) is a circular disc** introduced by James Russell. **CDs are **used to store data**, which can be executed in the future.
 
• Furthermore, the stored files on the compact disc can be** transferred to other computers,** through which **you can make a backup of all files**.
 
• It is a **secondary storage device.**
 
 
 
• **Hard disks:**
 
 
• A hard disk is also known as a hard drive or fixed disk. It is said to be rigid **magnetic disc that stores data.**
 
• A hard disk is a **non-volatile storage device **that **contains platters and magnetic disks rotating at high speeds**. Non-volatile means the **data retains when the computer shuts down.**
 
• It is a **secondary storage device.**
